• Trino has NO PIVOT keyword — use conditional aggregation (CASE WHEN / FILTER WHERE) ✓ (matches r07:731, r23:2092)
• Trino has NO QUALIFY — subquery + WHERE rn = 1 OR max_by(x, y) ✓ (matches r23:673, r23:880, r23:2184)
